title: HP computers are racist
summary: A short 2009 amateur video showing an HP MediaSmart webcam whose face tracking follows a white face but fails to track a black face. The uploader presents it as humorous.
why: HN cites it as the standard example of algorithmic bias in face detection and of how skewed training data produces biased tech.

quote.text: I also have some concerns of inadvertent "software racism". See for example, this video
